tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Vehicle should have valid registration with yellow number board or Green Board must be licensed for Commercial use and it should be covered under comprehensive Insurance throughout the contract period

Executive Engineer, Engineering Division, Bhadra CADA, Ranebennur reserves the right to terminate the contract at any time during the period of contract if the performance of the agency is not satisfactory
For any other Conditions/ information please refer the Notification and DTP
The vehicle service to be provided from November-2026 to Mar-2027 (5 months)
Monthly quoted rates shall be inclusive of all cost service tax and exclusive of GST (as per applicable taxes as per government order
Any Addendum/Corrigendum will be published in e-portal only.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should submit the any one year turnover certificate in last 03 years with last One year IT return.
Proof of ownership bidder or vehicle owner of vehicles such as RC Book be uploaded in the e-portal

The bidder shall be the owner of the vehicle or he shall get undertaking enclose/upload an undertaking from the vehicle owner stating that vehicle will be let out to the bidder for the whole contract period
The bidder should submit the Emission Test copy
The bidder should submit the PAN card copy
The bidder should submit the Vehicle Insurance copy
The vehicles must be registered on or after 01.01.2022
